me-topic-1-1-concept.concept_name: Vector Geometry, Linear Transformations, and Series
me-topic-1-1-concept.subject: Mathematics
me-topic-1-1-concept.decision_reason: Existing pool is comparatively deep; retain for a later mathematics-specific wave while the official 35% mathematics area remains represented.

me-topic-1-2-concept.concept_name: Models, Rates, Accumulation, and Differential Equations
me-topic-1-2-concept.subject: Mathematics
me-topic-1-2-concept.decision_reason: Largest current concept cohort; defer to avoid further mathematics concentration while engineering applications are thin.

me-topic-1-3-concept.subject: Mathematics
me-topic-1-3-concept.decision_reason: Useful prerequisite competency, but current direct board pool is healthier than the engineering-science and professional areas.

me-topic-2-1-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-1-concept.decision_reason: Thin existing pool, central to materials/design scope, and supports defensible analysis questions.

me-topic-2-2-concept.concept_name: Fluid Statics, Internal Flow, and Fluid Machines
me-topic-2-2-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-2-concept.decision_reason: Thin pool with strong foundational source support and high numerical/application breadth.

me-topic-2-3-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-3-concept.decision_reason: Core ME competency with authoritative thermodynamics and heat-transfer sources; expansion is bounded across distinct subskills.

me-topic-2-4-concept.concept_name: Energy Storage, Manufacturing Power, and Machine Life
me-topic-2-4-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-4-concept.decision_reason: Thin but semantically broad; defer until its mixed boundary is resolved through a separate source and taxonomy review.

me-topic-2-5-concept.concept_name: Economic Decisions, Process Variation, and Calibration
me-topic-2-5-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-5-concept.decision_reason: Source-ready but internally mixed; avoid padding a separate economics/quality wave into this thermal/mechanical milestone.

me-topic-2-6-concept.concept_name: Force Balance, Motion, Impact, and Vibration
me-topic-2-6-concept.subject: Engineering Sciences
me-topic-2-6-concept.decision_reason: Foundational prerequisite signal is strong, but selected items use it only as a material prerequisite; a dedicated dynamics/vibration wave is safer.

me-topic-3-1-concept.concept_name: Power Transmission, Joints, Bearings, and Fatigue
me-topic-3-1-concept.subject: Mechanical Engineering Professional Subjects
me-topic-3-1-concept.decision_reason: Most direct machine-design expansion target; broad source-backed design and capacity scenarios are available.

me-topic-3-2-concept.concept_name: Machining, Production Flow, Quality, and Economics
me-topic-3-2-concept.subject: Mechanical Engineering Professional Subjects
me-topic-3-2-concept.decision_reason: Thin professional pool with distinct machining, quality, flow, and process-selection applications.

me-topic-3-3-concept.concept_name: Cycles, Heat Exchange, Boilers, and Engines
me-topic-3-3-concept.subject: Mechanical Engineering Professional Subjects
me-topic-3-3-concept.decision_reason: Direct Power Plant Engineering crosswalk and high-value cycle/performance analysis potential.

me-topic-3-4-concept.concept_name: Pumps, Compressors, Heat Exchangers, and Air Conditioning
me-topic-3-4-concept.subject: Mechanical Engineering Professional Subjects
me-topic-3-4-concept.decision_reason: Very thin professional pool; source support covers fluid machinery and HVAC decisions without relying on volatile code trivia.

me-topic-3-5-concept.concept_name: Condition Monitoring, Reliability, and Energy Safety
me-topic-3-5-concept.subject: Mechanical Engineering Professional Subjects
me-topic-3-5-concept.decision_reason: Smallest professional cohort and high repeat-resistance value through reliability, maintenance, and safe-intervention scenarios.
